title: NPMScan
description: Detect malicious or vulnerable npm packages: registry search, OSV.dev and GitHub advisory lookups
summary: Detect malicious or vulnerable npm packages: registry search, OSV.dev and GitHub advisory lookups
offersHint: Detect malicious or vulnerable npm packages: registry search, OSV.dev and GitHub advisory lookups · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://npmscan.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_packages
toolsPreview.description: Search the npm registry by name or keywords. Returns matching packages with a link to their full npmscan.com risk/analysis page.

toolsPreview.name: get_package
toolsPreview.description: Fetch npm registry metadata for a package: latest version, install scripts (preinstall/postinstall are a key risk signal), maintainers, license, and recent version history. Includes a link to the full npmscan.com analysis page.

toolsPreview.name: get_package_version
toolsPreview.description: Fetch registry metadata for one exact version of a package (dependencies, install scripts, tarball). Use this to check a version pinned in a lockfile rather than the latest release.

toolsPreview.name: query_vulnerabilities
toolsPreview.description: Query OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities affecting an npm package, optionally scoped to one version. Use before recommending or installing a package.

toolsPreview.name: batch_query_vulnerabilities
toolsPreview.description: Query OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities across up to 100 npm packages at once — ideal for scanning a whole package.json/lockfile in one call.

toolsPreview.name: get_latest_advisories
toolsPreview.description: Browse recently published, reviewed GitHub Security Advisories for the npm ecosystem. Filter by severity, vulnerability category (XSS, SQL/NoSQL Injection, SSRF, Access Control, Code Injection, etc.), an affected package name, or look up one exact advisory by GHSA or CVE ID. Paginated with an opaque cursor: pass a previous response's nextCursor back in as cursor to fetch the next page.
